newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen Haniel Logistic buys into S African forwarder.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen Haniel Logistic buys into S African forwarder.

text.p: Thyssen Haniel Logistic GmbH (THL) said it has taken a minority stake in South African forwarder Eagle Freight (pty.) Ltd.
THL, the transport and logistics arm of German industrial conglomerate Thyssen AG, has bought a 35 percent stake in the forwarder back-dated to September 1, 1996, a company statement said.
Eagle Freight is one of the top ten South African freight forwarders, offering import and export services for air and sea freight, logistics and other forwarding activities, THL said.
The company employs 400 staff at four locations and generates an annual turnover of more than 300 million marks.
Wolfgang Kulenkampff, THL Air/Sea chairman, said: "With this stake we are beginning the expansion of our network outside the magic transport triangle of Europe, Asia and North America."
THL also aimed to benefit from the growing importance of South Africa in world trade, he added.
Eagle Freight will work exclusively with THL worldwide.
The THL Air/Sea division employs more than 1,500 staff worldwide and has an annual turnover of 900 million marks.
